metadata.title: Tech Earnings Are Sputtering. Why Defensive Stocks Are Winning the Season.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tech Earnings Are Sputtering. The AI Boom Faces a ‘Show Me’ Moment.
Wall Street loves an earnings beat, but tech stocks and the Magnificent Seven are barely clearing the bar this season.
